analytic.related_analytics: Related Analytics has been decoupled from this object, instead use `finding_info.related_analytics`. (since 1.0.0)

http_response.message: Redundant with the `code` and `status` attributes, which together convey the HTTP status code and its reason phrase. Use `code` for the numeric value and `status` for the human-readable label. (since 1.9.0)

location.isp: Use the `network_endpoint.isp` or `whois.isp` attribute according to your use-case. (since 1.5.0)

process.tid: `tid` is deprecated in favor of `ptid`. `ptid` has type `long_t` which can accommodate the thread identifiers returned by all platforms (e.g. 64-bit on MacOS). (since 1.6.0)
